description: This file declares the SetPlaybackRate class, which is a task for setting the playback rate in a media player context. It includes class members for context, wrappers, and the rate, and defines the constructor, destructor, and execute method.

classes.name: SetPlaybackRate
classes.description: A class representing a task to set the playback rate in a media player context, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the given context, wrappers, and rate.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the playback rate.
